title: Carlson's 1995 Warren Wilson College lectures proposing a Younger Dryas impact
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Carlson's 1995 Warren Wilson College lectures proposing a Younger Dryas impact, about 1995 at Warren Wilson College, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I gave re five lectures at Warren Wilson College in 1995. I believe it was [clears throat] where I basically talked about the younger dus, the mass extinctions, the rapid climate change.

plain: A researcher of ancient catastrophes, Randall Carlson, says that in 1995 he gave five lectures at Warren Wilson College in North Carolina about the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold spell near the end of the last ice age, along with the mass extinctions and rapid climate change of that time. He says he proposed back then that a cosmic impact caused it, which would mean he had the idea years before it became widely discussed.
